name: Protracted Meetings
overview: Scripture records extended gatherings of God's people, as seen in Solomon's fourteen-day feast attended by all Israel, spanning from Hamath to the river of Egypt (1 Kings 8:65; 2 Chronicles 7:8). These protracted meetings included solemn assemblies and dedicated altar celebrations lasting seven days each, culminating in joyful dismissal (2 Chronicles 7:9-10). Additionally, the assembly's decision to extend the feast for another seven days highlights the communal desire to continue worship and thanksgiving with gladness (2 Chronicles 30:23). Such prolonged gatherings underscore the importance of sustained corporate worship and dedication to the Lord.
